name: research-skills
description: Independent AI/ML experiment records, pilots, reports, requested Notion mirrors, and repository-scoped GPU execution with a shared uv environment.

interface.shortDescription: AI/ML experiments and shared-uv GPU workflows
interface.longDescription: A single collection for persistent AI/ML experiment records, standalone bounded pilots, evidence-based reports, requested Notion mirrors, and repository-scoped CUDA execution through one stable approval prefix and shared uv environment.
defaultPrompt: Manage persistent AI/ML experiment records, hypotheses, and execution evidence.
Plan a bounded pilot under representative real conditions using an existing entrypoint.
Interpret existing experiment results within the available evidence.
Inspect this repository's shared uv environment and the GPUs allocated on this server.
